paper_metadata.title: Effect of Nb addition in Ti-Zr-Cu-Ni(-Nb) amorphous/nanocrystalline brazing filler metals on the microstructure and mechanical properties of brazed TiAl alloy joints

evidence.quote: Amorphous/nanocrystalline Ti-Zr-Cu-Ni(-Nb) alloy ribbons were synthesized and used as novel BFMs for brazing TiAl alloy.

The superior strength (~236 MPa) of the joint brazed with the Ti45Zr25Cu10Ni10Nb10 BFM at 1223 K for 30 min was primarily attributed to the formation of B2 + O-Ti2AlNb phases and the reduction of the brittle (Ti, Zr)2(Cu, Ni) phase at the braze zone center.
